3: module RuboCop
4:   module Cop
5:     module Style
6:       # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
7:       # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
8:       # to avoid code repetition.
9:       # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
10:       # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
11:       #
12:       # @example
13:       #   # bad
14:       #   a = 'a'
15:       #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
16:       #
17:       #   # good
18:       #   a = 'a'
19:       #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
20:       #
21:       #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
22:       #   # elsewhere...
23:       #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
24:       #
25:       #   case foo
26:       #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
27:       #   # ...
28:       #   end
29:       #
30:       #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
31:       #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
32:       #
33:       # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
34:       #   # good
35:       #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
36:       #
37:       # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
38:       #   # bad
39:       #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
40:       #
41:       #   # good
42:       #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
43:       #
44:       # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
45:       #   # bad
46:       #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
47:       #
48:       # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
49:       #   # good
50:       #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
51:       #
52:       class MultipleComparison < Base
53:         extend AutoCorrector
54: 
55:         MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
56:               'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'
57: 
58:         def on_or(node)
59:           root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
60:           return unless node == root_of_or_node
61:           return unless nested_comparison?(node)
62: 
63:           return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
64:           return if values.size < comparisons_threshold
65: 
66:           range = offense_range(values)
67: 
68:           add_offense(range) do |corrector|
69:             elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
70:             prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"
71: 
72:             corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
73:           end
74:         end
75: 
76:         private
77: 
78:         # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
79:         def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, '(send $lvar :== $lvar)'
80: 
81:         # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
82:         def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
83:           (send $lvar :== $_)
84:         PATTERN
85: 
86:         # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
87:         def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
88:           (send $_ :== $lvar)
89:         PATTERN
90: 
91:         # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
92:         def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
93:           if node.or_type?
94:             find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
95:             find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
96:           elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
97:             return
98:           elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison?(node))
99:             return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?
100: 
101:             variables << var
102:             return if variables.size > 1
103: 
104:             values << obj
105:           end
106: 
107:           [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
108:         end
109:         # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
110: 
111:         def offense_range(values)
112:           values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
113:         end
114: 
115:         def variable_name(node)
116:           node.children[0]
117:         end
118: 
119:         def nested_comparison?(node)
120:           if node.or_type?
121:             node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
122:           else
123:             false
124:           end
125:         end
126: 
127:         def comparison?(node)
128:           simple_comparison?(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
129:         end
130: 
131:         def simple_comparison?(node)
132:           if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
133:              (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
134:             [var, obj]
135:           end
136:         end
137: 
138:         def root_of_or_node(or_node)
139:           return or_node unless or_node.parent
140: 
141:           if or_node.parent.or_type?
142:             root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
143:           else
144:             or_node
145:           end
146:         end
147: 
148:         def allow_method_comparison?
149:           cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
150:         end
151: 
152:         def comparisons_threshold
153:           cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
154:         end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
          return unless node == root_of_or_node
          return unless nested_comparison?(node)

          return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
          return if values.size < comparisons_threshold

          range = offense_range(values)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, '(send $lvar :== $lvar)'

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $lvar :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== $lvar)
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
          if node.or_type?
            find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
          elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
            return
          elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison?(node))
            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          simple_comparison?(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def evaluate_identity_comparison(node)
          @comparison_frames ||= []

            open_comparison_frame(:identity, node)
            walk_comparison_tree(node)
            operator = fetch_operator_record
            offense = false
            replacement = nil
            if node.nil?
              mark_offense_decision(node, false)
            elsif !node.respond_to?(:send_type?) || !node.send_type?
              mark_offense_decision(node, false)
            elsif operator && operator != :== && operator != :eql? && operator != :equal?
              mark_offense_decision(node, false)
            elsif identity_equality_operands?(node)
              replacement = identity_replacement_text(node)
              offense = !replacement.nil?
              mark_offense_decision(node, offense)
            else
              mark_offense_decision(node, false)
            end
            store_correction_record(node, replacement)
            decision = { offense: offense, replacement: replacement }
            close_comparison_frame
            decision
        end

            close_comparison_frame

        def object_id_message_node?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:send_type?) && node.send_type?
          if node.method?(:object_id)
            true
          elsif node.method?(:__id__)
            false
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def identity_equality_operands?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:receiver)
          receiver = node.receiver
          argument = node.first_argument if node.respond_to?(:first_argument)
          if receiver.nil? || argument.nil?
            false
          elsif object_id_message_node?(receiver) && object_id_message_node?(argument)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def identity_replacement_text(node)
          return nil unless node
          return nil unless node.respond_to?(:receiver) && node.receiver
          return nil unless node.respond_to?(:first_argument) && node.first_argument
          receiver = node.receiver.receiver if node.receiver.respond_to?(:receiver)
          argument = node.first_argument.receiver if node.first_argument.respond_to?(:receiver)
          if receiver.nil? || argument.nil?
            nil
          elsif !receiver.respond_to?(:source) || !argument.respond_to?(:source)
            nil
          else
            "#{receiver.source}.equal?(#{argument.source})"
          end
        end

        def identical_send_operands?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:binary_operation?)
          if !node.binary_operation?
            false
          elsif !node.respond_to?(:receiver) || !node.respond_to?(:first_argument)
            false
          elsif node.receiver == node.first_argument
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def identical_junction_operands?(node)
          return false unless node
          if node.respond_to?(:lhs) && node.respond_to?(:rhs)
            node.lhs == node.rhs
          elsif node.respond_to?(:left) && node.respond_to?(:right)
            node.left == node.right
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def float_equality_offense?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:arguments) && node.arguments.one?
          lhs = node.receiver if node.respond_to?(:receiver)
          rhs = node.first_argument if node.respond_to?(:first_argument)
          if float_literal_safe?(lhs) || float_literal_safe?(rhs)
            false
          elsif float_value_node?(lhs) || float_value_node?(rhs)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def float_value_node?(node)
          return false unless node
          type = node.type if node.respond_to?(:type)
          if type == :float
            true
          elsif type == :send || type == :csend
            float_send_result?(node)
          elsif type == :begin
            float_value_node?(node.children.first)
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def float_literal_safe?(node)
          return false unless node
          if node.respond_to?(:numeric_type?) && node.numeric_type? && node.respond_to?(:value) && node.value.zero?
            true
          elsif node.respond_to?(:nil_type?) && node.nil_type?
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def float_send_result?(node)
          return false unless node
          if node.respond_to?(:arithmetic_operation?) && node.arithmetic_operation?
            float_value_node?(node.receiver) || float_value_node?(node.first_argument)
          elsif FLOAT_RETURNING_OPERATORS.include?(node.method_name)
            true
          elsif node.receiver&.float_type?
            if FLOAT_INSTANCE_OPERATORS.include?(node.method_name)
              true
            else
              float_numeric_returning_method?(node)
            end
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def float_numeric_returning_method?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.receiver
          name = node.method_name
          if FLOAT_PHASE_OPERATORS.include?(name)
            Float(node.receiver.source).negative?
          elsif FLOAT_ROUND_OPERATORS.include?(name)
            precision = node.first_argument
            precision&.int_type? && Integer(precision.source).positive?
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def class_equality_decision(node)
          parts = class_comparison_parts(node)
          return nil unless parts
          receiver_node, class_node = parts
          return nil if class_node.respond_to?(:dstr_type?) && class_node.dstr_type?
          class_name = class_name_for_comparison(class_node, node)
          class_argument = class_name ? "(#{class_name})" : ''
          replacement = class_name ? "instance_of?#{class_argument}" : nil
          range = class_equality_offense_range(receiver_node, node)
          {
            range: range,
            class_argument: class_argument,
            replacement: replacement
          }
        end

        def class_comparison_parts(node)
          return nil unless node
          return nil unless node.respond_to?(:send_type?) && node.send_type?
          return nil unless CLASS_EQUALITY_OPERATORS.include?(node.method_name)
          receiver = node.receiver
          argument = node.first_argument
          return nil unless receiver && argument
          return nil unless receiver.send_type?
          if receiver.method?(:class)
            [receiver, argument]
          elsif class_name_query_method?(receiver.method_name)
            inner = receiver.receiver
            if inner && inner.send_type? && inner.method?(:class)
              [inner, argument]
            else
              nil
            end
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def class_name_for_comparison(class_node, node)
          receiver_method = node.children.first.method_name if node && node.children && node.children.first.respond_to?(:method_name)
          if class_name_query_method?(receiver_method)
            nested_receiver = class_node.receiver if class_node.respond_to?(:receiver)
            if nested_receiver && class_name_query_method?(class_node.method_name)
              return nested_receiver.source
            end
            if class_node.respond_to?(:str_type?) && class_node.str_type?
              value = trim_class_name_quotes(class_node)
              value = value.prepend('::') if class_comparison_requires_cbase?(class_node)
              return value
            elsif class_comparison_unknown_type?(class_node)
              return nil
            end
          end
          class_node.source
        end

        def class_name_query_method?(method_name)
          if method_name.nil?
            false
          elsif CLASS_NAME_QUERY_OPERATORS.include?(method_name)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def class_comparison_requires_cbase?(class_node)
          return false unless class_node
          if class_node.respond_to?(:each_ancestor)
            class_node.each_ancestor(:class, :module).any?
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def class_comparison_unknown_type?(class_node)
          return false unless class_node
          if class_node.respond_to?(:variable?) && class_node.variable?
            true
          elsif class_node.respond_to?(:call_type?) && class_node.call_type?
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def trim_class_name_quotes(class_node)
          source = class_node.source if class_node.respond_to?(:source)
          if source.nil?
            ''
          else
            source.delete('"').delete("'")
          end
        end

        def class_equality_offense_range(receiver_node, node)
          return node.source_range if receiver_node.nil? || node.nil?
          selector = receiver_node.loc.selector if receiver_node.respond_to?(:loc) && receiver_node.loc
          buffer = node.source_range.source_buffer if node.respond_to?(:source_range) && node.source_range
          if selector && buffer
            Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, selector.begin_pos, node.source_range.end_pos)
          else
            node.source_range
          end
        end

        def nil_comparison_decision(node, prefer_comparison)
          return nil unless node
          return nil unless node.respond_to?(:receiver) && node.receiver
          if prefer_comparison
            return nil unless nil_predicate_send?(node)
            { offense: true, replacement: prefer_nil_explicit_replacement(node) }
          elsif nil_comparison_send?(node)
            { offense: true, replacement: prefer_nil_predicate_replacement(node) }
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def nil_comparison_send?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:send_type?) && node.send_type?
          if NIL_COMPARISON_OPERATORS.include?(node.method_name) && node.first_argument && node.first_argument.nil_type?
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def nil_predicate_send?(node)
          return false unless node
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:send_type?) && node.send_type?
          if node.method?(:nil?)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def prefer_nil_explicit_replacement(node)
          source = node.source if node.respond_to?(:source)
          if source.nil?
            nil
          else
            source.sub('.nil?', ' == nil')
          end
        end

        def prefer_nil_predicate_replacement(node)
          source = node.source if node.respond_to?(:source)
          if source.nil?
            nil
          else
            source.sub(/\s*={2,3}\s*nil/, '.nil?')
          end
        end

        def walk_comparison_tree(node, collected = nil)
          collected ||= []
          return collected unless node
          collected << inspect_comparison_node(node)
          children = safe_child_nodes(node)
          if children.empty?
            collected
          else
            children.each { |child| walk_comparison_tree(child, collected) }
            collected
          end
        end


        def operator_profile(method_name)
          OPERATOR_PROFILES[method_name] || OPERATOR_PROFILES[:unknown]
        end

        def node_type_profile(type_name)
          NODE_TYPE_PROFILES[type_name] || NODE_TYPE_PROFILES[:unknown]
        end

        def comparison_inspector_for(type_name)
          COMPARISON_NODE_INSPECTORS[type_name] || :inspect_generic_operand
        end

        def send_category_flags(category, node)
          {
            equality: category == :equality,
            relational: category == :relational,
            case_equality: category == :case_equality,
            identity: category == :identity,
            index: category == :index,
            class_query: category == :class_query,
            predicate: category == :predicate,
            other: category == :other,
            argument_type: node.arguments.first && node_type_name(node.arguments.first)
          }
        end

        def inspect_comparison_node(node)
          return { kind: :missing } if node.nil?

          type = node_type_name(node)
          inspector = comparison_inspector_for(type)
          payload = send(inspector, node)
          payload[:profile] = node_type_profile(type)
          enrich_comparison_payload(node, payload)
        end

        def inspect_send_comparison(node)
          return { kind: :missing } if node.nil?
          return { kind: :non_send, type: node_type_name(node) } unless node.respond_to?(:send_type?) && node.send_type?

          method_name = node.method_name
          category = classify_comparison_operator(method_name)
          profile = operator_profile(method_name)
          payload = {
            kind: :send,
            method: method_name,
            category: category,
            argument_count: node.arguments.size,
            receiver_type: node.receiver && node_type_name(node.receiver),
            safe: false,
            source_length: node_source_text(node).length,
            profile: profile,
            identity: profile[:identity],
            predicate: profile[:predicate],
            index: profile[:index],
            class_query: profile[:class_query],
            commutative: profile[:commutative],
            arity: profile[:arity],
            description: profile[:description]
          }
          payload.merge(send_category_flags(category, node))
        end

        def inspect_csend_comparison(node)
          return { kind: :missing } if node.nil?
          return { kind: :non_csend, type: node_type_name(node) } unless node.respond_to?(:csend_type?) && node.csend_type?
          method_name = node.method_name
          payload = {
            kind: :csend,
            method: method_name,
            category: classify_comparison_operator(method_name),
            argument_count: node.arguments.size,
            receiver_type: node.receiver && node_type_name(node.receiver),
            safe: true
          }
          if equality_operator?(method_name)
            payload[:equality] = true
          elsif method_name == :[]
            payload[:index] = true
          elsif method_name == :nil?
            payload[:nil_predicate] = true
          elsif relational_operator?(method_name)
            payload[:relational] = true
          else
            payload[:call] = true
          end
          payload[:source_length] = node_source_text(node).length
          payload
        end

        def inspect_or_comparison(node)
          return { kind: :missing } if node.nil?
          return { kind: :non_or, type: node_type_name(node) } unless node.respond_to?(:or_type?) && node.or_type?

          lhs = node.lhs if node.respond_to?(:lhs)
          rhs = node.rhs if node.respond_to?(:rhs)
          {
            kind: :or,
            left_type: lhs && node_type_name(lhs),
            right_type: rhs && node_type_name(rhs),
            junction: true,
            identical: lhs && rhs && lhs == rhs,
            incomplete: lhs.nil? || rhs.nil?,
            source_length: node_source_text(node).length,
            profile: node_type_profile(:or)
          }
        end

        def inspect_and_comparison(node)
          return { kind: :missing } if node.nil?
          return { kind: :non_and, type: node_type_name(node) } unless node.respond_to?(:and_type?) && node.and_type?

          lhs = node.lhs if node.respond_to?(:lhs)
          rhs = node.rhs if node.respond_to?(:rhs)
          {
            kind: :and,

          if receiver && receiver.respond_to?(:send_type?) && receiver.send_type? && relational_operator?(receiver.method_name)
            true
          elsif receiver && receiver.respond_to?(:send_type?) && receiver.send_type? && equality_operator?(receiver.method_name)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def operator_commutative?(method_name)
          if equality_operator?(method_name)
            true
          elsif method_name == :===
            false
          elsif relational_operator?(method_name)
            false
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def receiver_is_literal?(node)
          receiver = extract_receiver_node(node)
          if receiver.nil?
            false
          else
            literal_operand?(receiver) || constant_operand?(receiver)
          end
        end

        def argument_is_literal?(node)
          argument = extract_argument_nodes(node).first
          if argument.nil?
            false
          else
            literal_operand?(argument) || constant_operand?(argument)
          end
        end

        def multiple_values_source(values)
          return '' unless values
          pieces = values.map do |value|
            if value.respond_to?(:source)
              value.source
            else
              value.to_s
            end
          end
          if pieces.empty?
            ''
          else
            pieces.join(', ')
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_include_template(variable, values)
          elements = multiple_values_source(values)
          argument = if variable.respond_to?(:lvar_type?) && variable.lvar_type?
                       variable_name(variable)
                     elsif variable.respond_to?(:source)
                       variable.source
                     else
                       node_source_text(variable)
                     end
          if elements.empty? || argument.nil? || argument == ''
            nil
          else
            "[#{elements}].include?(#{argument})"
          end
        end

        def enrich_comparison_payload(node, payload)
          return payload unless node && payload

          method_name = extract_method_name(node)
          type = node_type_name(node)
          analyzers = {
            send: :analyze_equality_send,
            csend: :analyze_safe_navigation_send,
            or: :analyze_or_chain,
            and: :analyze_and_chain
          }
          analyzer = analyzers[type]
          payload[:analysis] = send(analyzer, node) if analyzer
          payload[:hash_access] = hash_access_send?(node)
          payload[:safe_navigation] = safe_navigation_send?(node)
          payload[:chained] = chained_comparison_send?(node)
          payload[:commutative] = operator_commutative?(method_name)
          payload[:literal_receiver] = receiver_is_literal?(node)
          payload[:literal_argument] = argument_is_literal?(node)
          payload[:operator_profile] = operator_profile(method_name)
          payload[:node_profile] = node_type_profile(type)
          payload
        end

        def walk_and_enrich_comparison_tree(node)
          collected = walk_comparison_tree(node)
          if collected.nil? || collected.empty?
            []
          else
            collected
          end
        end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, <<~PATTERN
          (send lvar :== lvar)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs, <<~PATTERN
          (send ${lvar call} :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== ${lvar call})
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize
        def on_or(node)
          root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
          return unless node == root_of_or_node
          return unless nested_comparison?(node)

          return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
          return if values.size < comparisons_threshold

          range = offense_range(values)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            argument = variable.lvar_type? ? variable_name(variable) : variable.source
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{argument})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize

        private

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
          if node.or_type?
            find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
          elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
            return
          elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison(node))
            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          !!simple_comparison(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs(node)) || (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs(node))
            return if var.call_type? && !allow_method_comparison?

            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

        def allow_method_comparison?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def comparisons_threshold
          cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \

display.text:
class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
          return unless node == root_of_or_node
          return unless nested_comparison?(node)

          return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
          return if values.size < comparisons_threshold

          range = offense_range(values)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            argument = variable.lvar_type? ? variable_name(variable) : variable.source
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{argument})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, <<~PATTERN
          (send lvar :== lvar)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send ${lvar call} :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== ${lvar call})
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
          if node.or_type?
            find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
          elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
            return
          elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison?(node))
            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          !!simple_comparison?(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            return if var.call_type? && !allow_method_comparison?

            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

        def allow_method_comparison?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def comparisons_threshold
          cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
        end

        public

part.text:
All tests pass. The fix ports the upstream change for this issue to `lib/rubocop/cop/style/multiple_comparison.rb`:

- **`simple_comparison_lhs?` / `simple_comparison_rhs?` matchers** now capture `${lvar call}` instead of `$lvar`, so method calls — including hash access (`selection_data[:type]`) and safe navigation (`a&.do_something`) — can be recognized as the compared variable (lib/rubocop/cop/style/multiple_comparison.rb:84-92).
- **`simple_comparison`** skips comparisons where the variable side is a method call when `AllowMethodComparison: false` (lib/rubocop/cop/style/multiple_comparison.rb:136).
- **Autocorrection** emits `variable.source` for non-lvar variables instead of only the variable name, producing `["X", "Y"].include?(selection_data[:type])` (lib/rubocop/cop/style/multiple_comparison.rb:70-71).
- Added `Metrics/AbcSize` disable around `on_or`, matching upstream.

Validation: `multiple_comparison_spec.rb` (30/30, including the 4 previously failing hash-access/safe-navigation cases), plus the full `spec/rubocop/cop/style` suite (11521 examples) and dependent cop specs (`nil_comparison`, `class_equality_comparison`, `float_comparison`, `binary_operator_with_identical_operands`) all pass, with no new lint offenses in the edited region.
